source.description: Replacement handmade raster 3x2 marker-process contact sheet generated after the front-loaded v1 process was rejected.
source.notes: The rejected v1 sheet, assets, page, and plan are preserved under drafts/cartoon-rocket-planter-with-sprout/rejected-front-loaded-v1/.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels move from sparse primitives and placement ticks to the shell, three fins, window and sprout, ink with every color region, then finishing-only marker fill.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one body ellipse, one centerline, one top-rim axis, a window center cross, three fin attachment ticks, and one sprout gesture with two leaf-tip ticks.

final_elements.name: rocket planter shell
final_elements.description: One upright rounded rocket body with a curved nose and one open planter rim.

final_elements.name: three lower fins
final_elements.description: Exactly three rounded lower fins attached at the reserved body locations.

final_elements.name: round window
final_elements.description: One centered circular window with one simple inner ring.

final_elements.name: two-leaf sprout
final_elements.description: One curved stem with exactly two simple leaves growing from the open rim.

final_elements.name: highlights and shadow
final_elements.description: Two open-paper shell highlights and one short broken ground shadow.

final_elements.name: marker palette
final_elements.description: Black keeper outlines plus visible red shell, yellow fins, teal window, green sprout, and navy shadow regions.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The top-rim axis stops around the sprout gesture so the later stem grows from inside the planter.
The shell and ground routes stop at three attachment ticks rather than drawing through future fin silhouettes.

frames.step_name: Map the rocket with simple guides
frames.visible_job: Place one pale body ellipse, one vertical centerline, one top-rim axis, a window center cross, three fin attachment ticks, and one sprout gesture with two leaf-tip ticks.
construction_primitives: one tall body ellipse with one vertical centerline
one curved sprout gesture with two leaf-tip ticks
adds: window and fin placement without closed contours
must_not_show: black marker outlines or marker color

frames.visible_job: Connect only the rounded rocket body, curved nose, and open top rim over the pale construction while leaving fins, window, and leaves absent.
Add exactly three rounded fin contours at the established attachment ticks while keeping the window cross and sprout gesture open.
Draw one round window with an inner ring, one curved stem with exactly two leaf contours, two shell highlight reserves, and one broken shadow route.
adds: one round window and inner ring
one stem with exactly two leaves
two highlight reserves and one broken shadow route
must_not_show: new props, flames, face, or lettering

frames.visible_job: Ink only established contours, then place visible red, yellow, teal, green, and navy marker strokes in every major planned color region without completing the fills.
adds: one thick imperfect black keeper-line pass
visible red shell, yellow fins, teal window, green sprout, and navy shadow color regions
must_not_show: new props, flames, face, or lettering

final_step.visible_job: Only complete the established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and add small highlight and shadow accents.

rejection_checks: Panel 1 must remain under 30 percent structural completion and contain no closed fins, window, leaves, highlights, shadow, ink, or color.
Every later frame must add its assigned new geometry; only the fifth transition may rely mainly on darker line weight.
The first panel may use attachment ticks and gesture routes but may not preview future closed contours in pale gray.
Exactly three fins, one round window, one stem, and two leaves must persist after they are established.
Every major final color region must be visible in Panel 5 before the final completes the fills.
Reject any new flame, face, lettering, prop, vector-like finish, or non-cumulative redraw.
